Title: Evaluate GraphQL + JWT auth and composed schema

Description:
Consider adding GraphQL (Graphene) and JWT authentication to provide a unified, flexible API surface for complex queries (profiles + attendance + tasks) and token-based auth for clients.

Acceptance criteria:
- Prototype GraphQL schema that exposes profiles, activities and attendance.
- JWT login mutation and token refresh/verify endpoints.
- Documentation and example queries.

Notes:
- This can be optional — maintain REST endpoints in parallel during migration.

Priority: Low
